subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word segment for the underlined word in the given sentence.

Pintu has been advised to __reduce__ smoking by his family doctor.
solution:
The correct answer is: **cut down.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Cut down"** is a phrasal verb that means to reduce the amount or number of something, which in this case refers to smoking. It is synonymous with **"reduce"** in the context of the sentence. (कम करना)
 
• It is commonly used in relation to habits that one needs to lessen for health or other reasons.
 
 
• ​An **example** of correct usage is, "He decided to **cut down** on sugar to improve his diet."
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Lower down" **does not fit the context of the sentence as it is not typically used to refer to the action of reducing a habit such as smoking. (कम करें)
 
• **"Up down"** is not a recognized phrasal verb in English and does not convey a clear meaning.
 
• **"Less down" **is grammatically incorrect and not used in standard English.
